item.text:
I refactored the read side of the tree so the mutable core and the immutable view are cleaner separated.

The main change is that color is now a shared domain type in [RedBlackTreeColor.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTreeColor.java:1) instead of being private inside the tree and degraded to a boolean in snapshots. [RedBlackTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTree.java:17) now uses that shared enum directly, and [RedBlackTreeSnapshot.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTreeSnapshot.java:4) carries the full color information while also owning its own inorder traversal. That let me simplify `RedBlackTree.inorderValues()` and make the formatter and validator operate on a richer, more coherent snapshot model in [RedBlackTreeFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTreeFormatter.java:7) and [RedBlackTreeValidator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTreeValidator.java:5).

I also cleaned up a couple of leftovers in [RedBlackTreeDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTreeDemo.java:5) and [RedBlackTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/045_red_black_tree_insertion/RedBlackTree.java:1). Verified with `javac RedBlackTree.java RedBlackTreeColor.java RedBlackTreeFormatter.java RedBlackTreeSnapshot.java RedBlackTreeValidator.java RedBlackTreeDemo.java RedBlackTreeTest.java -cp lib/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.10.2.jar && java -jar lib/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.10.2.jar execute --class-path . --scan-class-path`; all 4 tests pass.
